name: T1w-to-T1w Registration
summary: Registers a moving T1-weighted image to a fixed T1-weighted image with ANTs antsRegistration (translation, rigid, affine and optional SyN stages) and outputs the transforms and the registered image.
description: Runs a multi-stage ANTs registration whose last stage is set by transformation (translation, rigid, affine or nonlinear SyN) and whose multiresolution depth is set by settings, then applies the result to the moving T1w. Use it for intra-subject longitudinal alignment or inter-subject/template normalisation of T1w images; the transforms can be reused by other Apps (for example tract transformation).

outputs.description: ANTs affine (affine.txt) and, for nonlinear registration, the warp and inverse warp fields.
Moving T1w resampled into the fixed image space.

parameters.description: The `settings` parameter controls the depth of the multiresolution (pyramidal) registration strategy used by ANTs. Higher settings correspond to more levels in the registration pyramid, starting from coarse alignment and progressively refining toward finer spatial correspondence.
Last registration stage to run: translation, rigid, affine or nonlinear (SyN); earlier stages are always included.
